user_prompt:
Create a single-panel, publication-ready scientific systems diagram for DeepMAST in a minimal Nature-style flat vector aesthetic. Use a clean white background, restrained colorblind-safe palette, crisp sans-serif typography, thin clean arrows, balanced spacing, and no decorative gradients, 3D effects, photorealism, or texture.

This must be an anchored rendering of an approved systems figure specification. Preserve the exact conceptual structure and exact box labels. Do not redesign the architecture.

Mandatory layout:
- Three horizontal bands only: Workflow Layer at top, Capability Layer in the middle, Resource Layer at bottom.
- Workflow is dominant and reads left to right.
- Solid arrows for main workflow.
- Dashed arrows for support relationships.
- Single panel only.

Workflow Layer exact boxes, left to right:
- Input
  subtitle: Spatial transcriptomics dataset and user-defined biological question
- Study Setup / Pipeline Builder
  subtitle: Builds the analysis plan from study goals and dataset context.
- ST Analysis Pipeline
  subtitle: Runs standardized ST analysis for clustering, neighborhood, pathways, and CCI.
  small keywords: clustering | neighborhood | pathway | CCI
- Prioritized L-R Candidates
  subtitle: Top-ranked ligand-receptor pairs from hybrid spatial and biological scoring.
  important: visibly smaller than the two deep modules so it reads as an intermediate artifact.
- Branch to two larger parallel modules:
  - Deep Biological Interpreter
    subtitle: Literature-grounded biological interpretation via specialized subagents.
    internal ribbon text: Planner -> Searcher -> Interpreter
  - Deep Drug Target Discovery
    subtitle: Staged translational target discovery and hypothesis generation.
    internal ribbon text: Evidence Assessor -> Deep Diver -> Hypothesis Generator -> Summarizer
- Converge into Final Report Synthesis
  subtitle: Combines biological and therapeutic evidence into the final report.
  small note: drug-target outputs incorporated into final synthesis
- Then Output
  subtitle: Validated findings, target evidence, and final report

Capability Layer must contain exactly three separate adjacent boxes:
- Hierarchical Agents
- Skills-guided Reasoning
- MCP Tool Interface
Requirements:
- Hierarchical Agents must be its own separate box.
- Skills-guided Reasoning must be the largest and most visually prominent capability box.

Resource Layer must contain exactly four separate adjacent boxes:
- ST analysis engines
- MCP servers
- Biological databases
- Literature and full-text RAG

Support-link rules:
- Skills-guided Reasoning supports Deep Biological Interpreter and Deep Drug Target Discovery.
- MCP Tool Interface supports ST Analysis Pipeline and Deep Drug Target Discovery.
- MCP Tool Interface connects downward to ST analysis engines and MCP servers only.
- Skills-guided Reasoning connects downward to Biological databases and Literature and full-text RAG only.

Critical corrections:
- Use plain text HITL callouts only. Do not use person icons or avatars.
- Include only two HITL callouts total: HITL study setup, and HITL selection + confirmation.
- Ensure every internal ribbon label is fully readable with no truncation, especially Summarizer and Hypothesis Generator.
- Do not truncate any workflow box titles.
- Keep spacing generous enough for manuscript readability.

Style requirements:
- Clean journal figure for a high-impact biology or methods paper.
- Minimal, precise, systems-diagram aesthetic.
- No visual clutter, no overlaps, no marketing-style iconography.
- Rounded rectangles, subtle fills, restrained color, and strong readability at manuscript scale.

iterations.prompt:
Create a high-quality scientific diagram with these requirements:

VISUAL QUALITY:
- Clean white or light background (no textures or gradients)
- High contrast for readability and printing
- Professional, publication-ready appearance
- Sharp, clear lines and text
- Adequate spacing between elements to prevent crowding

TYPOGRAPHY:
- Clear, readable sans-serif fonts (Arial, Helvetica style)
- Minimum 10pt font size for all labels
- Consistent font sizes throughout
- All text horizontal or clearly readable
- No overlapping text

SCIENTIFIC STANDARDS:
- Accurate representation of concepts
- Clear labels for all components
- Include scale bars, legends, or axes where appropriate
- Use standard scientific notation and symbols
- Include units where applicable

ACCESSIBILITY:
- Colorblind-friendly color palette (use Okabe-Ito colors if using color)
- High contrast between elements
- Redundant encoding (shapes + colors, not just colors)
- Works well in grayscale

LAYOUT:
- Logical flow (left-to-right or top-to-bottom)
- Clear visual hierarchy
- Balanced composition
- Appropriate use of whitespace
- No clutter or unnecessary decorative elements
